answer: New agents gain influence only after posting a time-locked bond at a single inlet: the stake must stay unspendable for one full epoch before that key can attest or grade. The bond is sunk into a karst of linked slashing channels; if clone keys move in lockstep, every connected deposit is drained together. Settlement credit is then capped per bonded key, like a scarce saffron allotment, so spinning cheap identities cannot multiply voting weight beyond the capital already locked.
